core_idea: Lobotomy E.G.O::Lamp Gregor is a Tank / Status Specialist / Support — **Sinking** and **Burn** stacking — damage and clash power scale off the combined count on the target. Sinking drains SP when the afflicted unit is hit. Holds the front with **Aggro** but has no mitigation of its own — pair it with healing or Protection support. Support passive (**Were There More Lives to be Saved?**) keys off **deployment order** — set your main carry as #1 deployed before the fight. **SP regenerator** — restores ally **SP** through passives and key skills.
playstyle_guide:
- **Were There More Lives to be Saved?** watches the **#1 deployed ally** — arrange the dashboard so the intended carry is first in line.
- Skills check **6+ Burn** — favour those coins when stacked.
- Front-load **+4 Aggro** on the slot you want enemies to target.
- Use **Haste** on attack turns — **Guard** covers defense; this is not an Evade rotation.
- **SP sustain** fires at **each turn** — restores **teammates**.
- S3 carries Unbreakable Coin — commit it when the clash strongly favors you.

**S1 — Intense Stare: Zero Range** (BP 3, CP +4, 2 coins): rolls — low 3, high 11 (Slightly Low).
- Peak output requires both conditions: If any of the following conditions are met, Coin Power +1 | - If target's Speed is faster than this unit's by 3 or more.

**S2 — Destroy the Visible with the Invisible** (BP 3, CP +3, 4 coins): rolls — low 3, high 15 (Slightly Low).
- Peak output requires both conditions: If any of the following conditions are met, Clash Power +2 | - If target's Speed is faster than this unit's by 3 or more.
- Inflict +2 Sinking Count; [On Hit] Deal (30% of this Coin's final damage) Blunt damage
- Inflict 1 Sinking; [On Hit] Deal (30% of this Coin's final damage) Blunt damage

**S3 — Salvation for those Enchanted by the Lamp** (BP 5, CP +4, 3 coins): rolls — low 5, high 17 (Average / Extremely High stacked).
- Peak output requires both conditions: If any of the following conditions are met, Coin Power +1 and deal +40% damage | - If target's Speed is faster than this unit's by 3 or more.
- converts coins to Unbreakable under condition

Combat passive — **Dazzling Lamp**: Turn Start: Gain 1 Lamp.
  - External effects cannot change this unit's Min. and Max. Speeds.
  - When chaining Skills, this unit can redirect the Attack Skill's targeting to itself regardless of Speed (Focused Encounters only).

Combat passive — **Eyes Bright Like Lamps**: Combat Start: Gain 1 Lamp for every 2 Gloom Reson. (max 3).
  - Combat Start: If an enemy has Dazzle, heal 5 SP.
  - Turn End: Apply Guardians of the Forest next turn to the ally with the earliest Deployment order among those that do not fit the followin….

Defense skill — **Guard: The Wick of Burned Feathers**: Clashable Guard.
  - [Combat Start] Gain Lamp up to 8 Stack.
  - [Turn End] Apply 1 Haste next turn to (Bind on self / 2) other allies with the slowest Speed (once per turn.
